title: Bound retained numerical arena backing and capacity replay scope
body:
PR2825 bounds occupied numerical content but leaves erased backing open. This package proves an exact source-bound high-water recurrence for unchanged PR2697 `words.Arena`, including blank cells, LEFT/RIGHT positions and permanent templates.

Under PR2825's existing successful first-range caller contracts, with all entry live Words L, already allocated entry slots K and digit widths b:

```
retained numerical array cells
<= (max(K_R,L_R+37672)+1)(b_R+2)
 + (max(K_I,L_I+41)+1)(b_I+2).
```

Two arenas retain separate historical peaks. A literal sequential-phase example retains 31 cells despite a 21-cell simultaneous live maximum. The proof also distinguishes the pending allocation before live registration. Capacity replay requires an independently legal trace or successful reference run; a successful-call bound alone does not establish unconditional caller admission. The full-sized rectangle fixture is a synthetic allocator schedule, not actual caller sharpness.

Validation: registered CPython 3.12 replay; 1,078 reachable states/2,106 edges; nine semantic/integrity controls; separate AI checker with 10,164 histories/317,005 intermediate samples; all commands in a read-only Git-free optimized CPython 3.14 export with empty PATH. Selected-record integrity passes. Hosted CI is a separate gate.

Only `research/selected-numerical-arena-backing/` is added. Source/conditional proof pins are PR2697 `a53fdf4bcbe33c6732f0bec1badc8c023380f9d1` and PR2825 `b553e912bcddef550d9fae6033041ff683399ebe`. Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, Nick Petalas, Arham Tahir, David Arias, ywz65, Ross Richardson and retained notices. New work by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex and a separate math-storage-lifetimes AI audit, Apache-2.0.

No full caller or physical reserve, unconditional capacity admission, general failure safety, supplier admission, formal-kernel proof or new kappa. PR2769/2809's physical work remains separate. Next: prove all noncapacity-valid caller prefixes and join the remaining storage categories at common physical cuts.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-numerical-arena-backing`.

[Canonical claim and finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18961690). Scope changes from selected-stock-envelope to this released backing handoff; picker/guidance/source freshness and overlap limits are recorded in TASK.json and VALIDATION.md. Scientific base remains da4f4fec; submission main b1f581c3 had unchanged guidance, selected record and runner with no package collision. No selected-frontier files changed.
